case.title: Nomad token bridge (BridgeRouter proxy), Ethereum, 1-2 Aug 2022
case.period: hack: baseline before the incident, then the drain
case.notes: Copycat drain: hundreds of addresses replayed the exploit calldata. Other drained tokens (e.g. CQT, HBOT, GERO, IAG) are not tracked.
case.coverage: Tracked: USDT, USDC, DAI, FRAX, WBTC, WETH. Untracked small tokens (CQT, HBOT, GERO, ...) explain the gap to the reported ~$190M. A ~$20M legitimate outflow on 25 Jul 2022 to 0x3c0fa064... is a known false-alarm candidate.

price_note: Stablecoins and FRAX at $1; WBTC at Chainlink BTC / USD 22,987.72; WETH at Chainlink ETH / USD 1,627.44 (answers at block 15259101). Native ETH is not included except where it passed through WETH (rows with kind weth_wrap / weth_unwrap).
